text:
oliver: rolled runtime-2.18.0 to canary (eu-central) at 11:05Z. Deploybot auto-applied a soft-pin for model 'rerank-pro' after signature verification mismatches on some requests. Seeing small routing rejects (~0.4%). Should we keep pinned while we investigate?

deploybot: Deploy note: runtime-2.18.0 -> canary started 2026-05-10T11:05Z. Pin: soft, scope=cohort=canary, models=rerank-pro. Observability tags: signature, auth. Link: https://deploy.redwood/6301234567 :robot_face:

devon: Logs: `sig-verify failed: expected v2 signature, got v1` on ~7 instances. Rejection rate ~0.35% of canary. Likely SDK clients still signing with v1.

mira: SDK note: sdk-java 2.4.0 switched to v2 signatures by default; we published a compatibility shim in 2.4.1 that sends header X-RW-SIG=legacy when v1 is needed. Many customers are still on 2.3.x.

ops-sre: Given low impact, recommend: 1) convert hard behavior -> keep soft-pin 2) add opt-in routing for legacy-sig header: header X-RW-SIG==legacy -> runtime-2.17 3) add temporary permit flag in runtime-2.18 to accept v1 signatures for canary only until customers upgrade. I can stage the routing.

sam: I'll update release notes: "runtime-2.18: signature format bumped to v2; customers on older SDKs may need to upgrade or set X-RW-SIG=legacy in requests. We recommend upgrading to sdk-java 2.4.1+." Also ping Dedicated accounts in eu-central.

deploybot: Applied header-based fallback rule at 11:12Z for cohort=canary. Also added audit log entry for legacy-sig traffic.

ops-sre: Added alert: if signature rejection >1% sustained 5m -> automatic rollback to runtime-2.17 for canary. Also toggled runtime-2.18 canary to accept legacy signatures behind a feature flag for 60m.

devon: Running quick compatibility eval: with header X-RW-SIG=legacy routed to 2.17, request success back to baseline. With feature-flagged 2.18 nodes accepting v1, success also restored.

mira: I'll coordinate a small SDK patch note and post a migration snippet showing how to set the header. Also adding console banner for eu-central: "If you see signature rejects, add X-RW-SIG=legacy or upgrade SDK."

oliver: Plan: 1) keep soft-pin for 1h 2) route legacy header to runtime-2.17 3) enable temporary accept-v1 flag on canary 2.18 for 60m 4) monitor signature rejects and auto-rollback threshold 5) sam/mira handle release notes + customer comms. If rejects spike above threshold, rollback will be executed.

sam: Release notes updated and outreach started. I'll post final status after 1h.

oliver: Thanks all — keeping watch. :eyes:
